title: Idle Task
text: Create free-running task, 1 input, 1 output, {Task numbers} sets Identifies created tasks by numbers; {Preemption flags} sets the number of storage buffers and {Enable simulation port} enables peripheral simulation port to block. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Task numbers
params.values: Identifies created tasks by numbers double (default) | single | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | int64 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | uint64 | Boolean | bus

params.name: Preemption flags
params.values: Number of storage buffers 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable simulation port
params.values: Enable peripheral simulation port to block off (default) | on
